title: Name the checkpoint behind the #1042 status link
body:
## Summary
- The historical section "Historical status through #1042" prints `0.001672188119205421` and links Selected record to `certificates/selected-result.json`.
- That file carries the live kappa `836330098538459/500000000000000000`. The printed decimal is `certificates/checkpoints/frontier1042.json`, which the live record names as `previous_record`.
- The status page is unchanged, and the selected exponent is unchanged.
